name: How long does a bathroom tile and stone installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom tile and stone installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom tile installation typically takes 3 to 7 working days, depending on room size and project scope. The timeline begins with demolition and subfloor inspection, followed by installing cement backer boards and a certified waterproofing membrane. Laying the tile, cutting intricate layouts or niches, and letting the thinset mortar cure properly takes 24 to 48 hours. Grouting, applying sealant, and finishing caulking add another day or two. Custom shower pans, extensive mosaic patterns, or structural floor leveling can extend this schedule further.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom tile projects take between 3 and 7 days, allowing proper time for subfloor prep, waterproofing, tile setting, curing, and grouting.
